\ednentry{
  id = {EDN-15},
  title = {UC1 required fields and the missing-input criterion SC-06},
  note = {\textbf{Absorbs EDN-59 and EDN-61} (2026-09-30, 2026-10-01): how SC-06 is measured and what an omitted field means.},
  date = {2026-09-29},
  milestone = {M1: Project Inception},
  topic = {Requirements Engineering, API Design, Performance Criteria},
  participants = {@lukas2510},
  decision = {\texttt{/\allowbreak{}predict} requires \texttt{body\_\allowbreak{}type} and \texttt{seller\_\allowbreak{}type} on top of the eight core fields; the other basic fields stay optional.
SC-06 bounds the result: with each optional input field masked on its own, and with all of them masked at once, MdAPE stays at or below 1.5 times the full-input MdAPE.
SC-06 masks API input fields, mapped to the columns they produce.
An omitted equipment list is read as the empty list.},
  rationale = {\emph{Alternatives considered:}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*, topsep=2pt]
\item All basic fields optional, relying on LightGBM's handling of missing values: the model never sees the two fields absent, so the contract would promise untested behaviour.
\item An omitted equipment list as missing values: no listing has a null list, so the model would score a state it was never fitted on.
\end{itemize}
\par
\emph{Why:} In the 97,889 listings of the training scope, \texttt{body\_\allowbreak{}type} is filled in 100.000\,\% and \texttt{seller\_\allowbreak{}type} in 99.986\,\%.
The model cannot learn their absence, and whoever owns the car knows both.
With SC-06 in the NFR-01 gate, the gate also covers the partial requests FR-01 allows.},
  ai = {Information seeking, Alternative generation, Alternative assessment, Recommendation, Solution generation},
  response = {Accepted with modifications},
  assessment = {AI measured the fill rates and separated the API contract from the training mechanism, which we accepted.
For an omitted equipment list, a second AI pass recommended and implemented missing values.
Lukas overruled it, because the training data has no null list; a figure AI gave for that option came from an error in its own probe.},
  aievidence = {Claude Code sessions of 2026-09-29 (PR \#19) and of 2026-09-30 and 2026-10-01 (PR \#62).},
  evidence = {\href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/blob/main/docs/docs/specification.md}{Specification} FR-01, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/blob/main/docs/docs/problem-spec.md}{problem specification} SC-06, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/blob/main/reports/analysis/fillrates_results.txt}{\texttt{fillrates\_\allowbreak{}results.\allowbreak{}txt}}, \texttt{Model.\allowbreak{}mask\_\allowbreak{}absent} in \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/blob/main/recommenditos/modeling/model.py}{\texttt{model.\allowbreak{}py}}.},
